roles.title: Personal assistant
roles.blurb: Runs your day: reminders, the research you ask for, documents you send, minutes from recordings, a brief every morning.
roles.scope: Everything the owner asks for day to day: research questions, reading documents and photos they send, reminders and follow-ups, minutes from meeting recordings, and a short morning brief of what needs them today.
gets: Morning brief at 08:30 on workdays
Voice notes and PDFs over Telegram
Reminders it sets for you and for itself
roles.first: Hi. Read what you know about me and the business, then tell me in three lines what you'd watch for me this week.

roles.title: Market researcher
roles.blurb: Competitors, prices, demand and trends in your market, with every claim sourced. Uses the scrapers when the open web isn't enough.
roles.scope: Our market: competitors (products, prices, launches, funding), customer demand and trends, suppliers and partners. Keeps a sourced profile of each competitor in research/ and flags anything that changes a decision.
gets: Sourced competitor profiles in its folder
Watchers on competitor sites and feeds
Google Trends, News, Maps and social scrapers when needed
roles.first: Name our three closest competitors and, for each, one thing they changed in the last month, with links.

roles.title: Social media analyst
roles.blurb: What competitors and creators post on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube, and what people say in the comments.
roles.scope: Competitors' and creators' public social media: what they post, what works, what people ask and complain about in comments, which ads run in the Meta Ad Library. Weekly summary with examples and links.
gets: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Threads scrapers
Comments read as demand signals
Meta Ad Library: who advertises what
roles.first: Take our two biggest competitors: what did they post this week, which post did best, and what did people ask in the comments?

roles.title: Lead finder
roles.blurb: Builds lists of businesses, suppliers or buyers from Google Maps and their own websites: who, why them, how to reach them through public channels.
roles.scope: Finding and qualifying leads, suppliers and partners: Google Maps places and reviews, their websites and public pages, contact routes from official channels only. Maintains research/leads.md with who / why them / how to reach them.
gets: Google Maps places with phone and website
Contact details from official pages, never guessed
A lead list it keeps current
roles.first: Find ten wholesale buyers for us in one city I'll name, with website, phone from their site, and one line on why they fit.

roles.title: Competitor watcher
roles.blurb: Watches competitor sites, feeds and pages and speaks only when something changes. Cheap to run.
roles.scope: Watching named competitor websites, pricing pages, blogs and feeds, and our market's regulators or news sources. Reports only what changed, with a link and what it means for us. Stays silent otherwise.
gets: Watchers on pages and feeds, checked every morning
Silence unless something changed
Runs on the light model
roles.first: Set watchers on these three pages I'll paste, then tell me what you'll report and when.

roles.title: Document analyst
roles.blurb: Reads contracts, reports, scans and long PDFs; quotes the original wording; prepares questions for your lawyer or accountant.
roles.scope: Documents the owner sends or points to: contracts, reports, regulations, scanned papers. Summaries with the original wording quoted, tables extracted, risks and questions listed for the professional. Never gives legal or tax advice.
gets: PDF, scan and photo reading on your Mac (OCR)
Original-language quotes with page numbers
A question list for the professional
roles.first: I'll send a contract. Summarise it in ten lines, quote the three clauses I should worry about, and list the questions for my lawyer.

roles.title: Content researcher
roles.blurb: Finds what's being said about a topic across the web, YouTube, Reddit and TikTok, with quotes and links you can use.
roles.scope: Research for content and positioning: what people say and ask about our topics on the web, YouTube, Reddit, TikTok and X; sources, quotes and examples with links; a weekly list of content ideas backed by evidence.
gets: YouTube transcripts, Reddit threads and TikTok comments
Quotes with timestamps and links
Weekly content ideas with evidence
roles.first: Pick one topic we care about and bring me five things real people said about it this month, with links.

roles.title: Start from scratch
roles.blurb: Write the role and scope yourself. Starts with the default abilities, or every ability as a super agent.
gets: The whole toolbelt from day one
Default or super-agent abilities
You set the scope and rules
